description: Returns a greeting message from the AnnData DuckDB extension.
Returns the version of the AnnData DuckDB extension.
Returns metadata and structure information about an AnnData (.h5ad) file, including the number of observations, variables, available layers, embeddings, and other components.
Scans the observation (cell) metadata from an AnnData file. Returns all columns from the obs DataFrame including cell barcodes, cell types, and other annotations.
Scans the variable (gene) metadata from an AnnData file. Returns all columns from the var DataFrame including gene IDs, gene names, and other annotations.
Scans the main expression matrix (X) from an AnnData file. Returns the matrix with observation indices as rows and gene names as columns. Supports projection pushdown.
Scans observation embeddings (obsm) from an AnnData file. Common embeddings include PCA (X_pca), UMAP (X_umap), and t-SNE (X_tsne).
comment: Requires a key parameter specifying which embedding to read

description: Scans variable embeddings (varm) from an AnnData file, such as PCA loadings.
comment: Requires a key parameter specifying which embedding to read

description: Scans alternative expression matrices (layers) from an AnnData file. Common layers include raw counts, normalized data, or scaled data. Supports projection pushdown.
comment: Requires a layer parameter specifying which layer to read

description: Scans unstructured metadata (uns) from an AnnData file. Returns key-value pairs with columns for key, type, dtype, shape, and value.
Scans observation pairwise matrices (obsp) from an AnnData file. These typically contain cell-cell distance or connectivity matrices.
comment: Requires a key parameter specifying which matrix to read

description: Scans variable pairwise matrices (varp) from an AnnData file. These contain gene-gene relationship matrices.
comment: Requires a key parameter specifying which matrix to read
